findings.fix: State the concrete, layer-independent justification for the new lemmas (generic fiber-counting infrastructure, Roadmap: none), or hold them until the Layer 1 Sturm-Tarski / Layer 2 subresultant material that sign_matrix consumes is on main or in an open PR.
findings.issue: The description cites RealAlgebraicGeometry Layer 3 (sign determination, sign_matrix) as the target. The roadmap's own dependency table lists Layers 1 and 2 as inputs to Layer 3, and neither exists on main: there is no Sturm-Tarski, no subresultant, no real-closure material in the repository at all. Building Layer 3 periphery ahead of the stage it depends on is speculative.

summary: The relocation and generalization of occCount is a single in-scope topic, but four new lemmas (occCount_pos, occCount_of_notMem_range, occCount_of_injective, occCount_apply_of_injective) have no in-repo consumer and are justified only by an unsubmitted sign-matrix PR targeting Layer 3, whose stated input layers 1 and 2 are entirely absent from the repository. Drop the unused lemmas and land them with the consumer that needs them.
